AUTH.value: IBM Db2 for z/OS, IBM IMS DL/I
IBM CICS Transaction Server, IBM IMS TM

modules.name: CardDemo base application
modules.what_it_does: credit-card account, card, customer, transaction, bill-payment and user administration online (CICS/BMS over VSAM), plus the batch that loads the VSAM files, posts daily transactions, calculates interest and prints statements and reports

modules.name: Credit card authorizations (IMS, Db2, MQ)
modules.what_it_does: takes card authorization requests from MQ, decides and stores them in an IMS HIDAM database, lets operators view pending authorizations and mark fraud in Db2, and purges expired authorizations in batch

modules.name: Transaction type management (Db2)
modules.what_it_does: lets administrators list and maintain transaction type reference data in Db2 online, and maintains and extracts the same tables in batch

modules.name: Account and date inquiry over MQ (VSAM, MQ)
modules.what_it_does: answers account-detail and system-date inquiries that arrive as MQ request messages, reading the base account VSAM file
